answer.revision: The thesis that India stands outside world history is shaken by the observation that the state here, despite its apparent stasis, generates a civil society and a public opinion that engage with and judge the individual, suggesting an internal movement of freedom rather than a static dream.
answer.says: Aap toh philosopher lagte ho, not a chai drinker. Walk your tombs, but don't drop my cup on the grass. I'll be here if you get thirsty again.
answer.thought: Sunil's words are a mirror held up to my own abstraction; he sees the philosopher in the man who speaks of infinity while standing in the particular. I shall take his advice and walk the tombs, letting the grey light and the stone speak to the dialectic of the spirit, to see if this 'dawn' holds any motion I have missed.
